source: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database (SBDB) and Horizons APIs
note: One row per body, columns as in "fields". Angles in degrees, q in au, tp and epoch as Julian days (TDB). validFrom/validTo: Julian days between which our Sun-only position stays within 1° of Horizons. covParams: number of fitted parameters (6 = gravity only); covShard: file in public/data/cov with its covariance, only where the uncertainty cloud is within 0.8 to 1.25 times Horizons' own uncertainty.
